cards.card_text: The psalmist says, "let them be caught in the schemes they devise." Meanwhile the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart, blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD, bragging like a guy posting his new car in the group chat before the first payment even clears.
cards.verse_text: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.
cards.snippet: …boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.
